ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" --- { accountId: payload.accountId, displayName: payload.displayName, emailAddress: payload.emailAddress }

logger.doc:name: Log create
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Creating Jira issue for opportunity " ++ (vars.request.sfOpportunityId default "n/a") ++ " (correlation " ++ (vars.request.correlationId default correlationId) ++ ")"]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import try from dw::Runtime output application/java var issueTypeCode = vars.request.issueType default "SYSTEM_SETUP" var screenProp = try(() -> p('jira.screens.' ++ issueTypeCode)) --- if (screenProp.success and !isEmpty(trim((screenProp.result default "") as String))) (((screenProp.result as String) splitBy ",") map trim($)) contains "assignee" else true

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { key: payload.key, id: payload.id, url: "https://" ++ p('jira.host') ++ "/browse/" ++ payload.key }

choice.doc:name: Assignee configured and on the screen?

logger.doc:name: Log assign failure
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Created " ++ vars.created.key ++ " but could not assign it to " ++ vars.assigneeAccountId ++ ": " ++ (error.description default "unknown error")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import HMACWith from dw::Crypto output application/java var validate = (p('jira.webhook.validateSignature') default "true") == "true" var expected = "sha256=" ++ lower(HMACWith(p('secure::jira.webhookSecret') as Binary, vars.rawBody as Binary, "HmacSHA256")) --- if (validate) (lower(vars.signature default "") == expected) else true

logger.message: Jira webhook rejected: invalid or missing X-Hub-Signature

logger.doc:name: Ignore non-status update
logger.message: #["Webhook for " ++ (payload.issueKey default "?") ++ " ignored: no status change"]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output text/plain // Values are generated by us; anything outside [A-Za-z0-9_-:.] is stripped so nothing foreign can enter the JQL fun clean(s) = ((s default "") as String) replace /[^A-Za-z0-9_\-:.]/ with "" fun quoted(s) = "\"" ++ clean(s) ++ "\"" --- "labels = " ++ quoted(vars.searchLabel) ++ (if (isEmpty(clean(vars.searchProject))) "" else " AND project = " ++ quoted(vars.searchProject)) ++ " ORDER BY created ASC"

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" var jiraDateFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ" fun toDateTime(s) = if (s == null) null else (((s as DateTime { format: jiraDateFormat }) >> "UTC") as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'" }) --- (payload.issues default []) map ((i) -> { key: i.key, id: i.id, url: "https://" ++ p('jira.host') ++ "/browse/" ++ i.key, project: i.fields.project.key, issueType: i.fields.issuetype.name, summary: i.fields.summary, status: { id: i.fields.status.id, name: i.fields.status.name, category: i.fields.status.statusCategory.key }, sfOpportunityId: i.fields[p('jira.fields.sfOpportunityId')], created: toDateTime(i.fields.created), updated: toDateTime(i.fields.updated) })
